llmModelName.description: The name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} to be used for the process of follow queries.

rewriterPrompt.description: The {@link Genai.Prompt} that should be used.

nExamples.description: The maximum number of examples to retrieve.

minVectorDistance.description:
Specifies the minimum vector distance allowed for similarity search. If set to 0, then exact matches to query are allowed.
Notice the few-shot retriever uses cosine distance to calculate vector dissimilarity (ranges from 0 to 2).

maxVectorDistance.description:
Specifies the maximum vector distance allowed for similarity search. The greater this value is, the higher
dissimilarity from query is allowed. It's usually recommended to set a lower maxVectorDistance to ensure the retrieved
examples are relevant enough to the context.
Notice the few-shot retriever uses cosine distance to calculate vector dissimilarity (ranges from 0 to 2).
